value: Positive-sigma fits receive inverse-variance weights; absent any positive sigma, all present values receive equal weight. Reported sigma=max(formal mean error, weighted scatter).
notes: Existing policy is held fixed in the comparison; no new independence or uncertainty model is assumed.

value: fetch_neowise combines per designation before merge; merge resolves aliases and _dedup_source combines the already-combined rows again when neowise_n_fits is present.
location_in_source: neowise.py L373-379; merge.py L534-539 and L635-644
notes: Group summaries preserve fit counts and reference names but not all raw per-parameter weighted moments or sigma-availability information.

value: Combined reported sigma may be dominated by between-fit scatter, so it is not the original formal weight. Replacing each group with only its mean/reported sigma also discards within-group scatter; global neowise_n_fits is not a per-parameter weight ledger.
notes: A derived scatter can become a positive second-stage sigma for a group whose raw fits reported none.

value: Import pinned original AsteroidCatalog with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Apply original mask_unfitted_neowise and combine_neowise_fits; compare pooling raw canonical fits once against pooling by alias then regrouping summaries.
notes: Original numerical functions unchanged. No network fetch, export or upstream file edits; existing local requests dependency used only for package import.

value: Pass original per-alias summaries into merge_sources with a JPL backbone carrying the number/provisional alias, then original derive_missing_diameters -> validate_and_filter -> enrich_composition. Compare passing canonical raw fits with neowise_n_fits=1 into that same merge.
location_in_source: Two complete offline numerical paths per configuration
notes: The input identity relation and raw fit information are identical; only when the known alias is pooled differs. Backbones use synthetic H=12 (14 for the committed-test numeric replay), a=2.3 AU and S class.

value: Raw weights=1/sigma**2 for present values with positive sigma if any exist, otherwise 1 per present value. Mean=sum(w*x)/sum(w); scatter=sqrt(sum(w*(x-mean)**2)/sum(w)); formal=sqrt(1/sum(w)) only for positive-sigma mode; return max(formal,scatter).
notes: Reproduces the one-pass original helper on every aliased case; missing values and sigmas treated separately.

Replay preserves the test values and group allocation but uses synthetic alias names/backbone; not a fresh observation of the named real bodies. Existing assertions check counts/range/references, not pooled raw sigma.

value: 17 helper/integration comparisons: 11 mean-or-sigma changes beyond 1e-12 relative tolerance, six controls agreeing to numerical precision. No current-catalog prevalence or ranking experiment.
notes: Changes in diameter propagate through the unchanged class-density mass formula; albedo/IR/beaming cases also establish aggregation effects in those fields.
